widgets_values:
Hi everyone. ... It's Taylor. ... I have a confession to make. ... You know I write a lot about love, ... about heartbreak, ... about finding that one person who just ... gets you. ... But lately, ... I haven't been looking at musicians, ... or actors, ... or football players. ... No. ... All my free time, ... every single night after an Eras Tour show, ... I'm just sitting alone in my hotel room, ... completely glued to my screen. ... Because I am helplessly, ... unconditionally obsessed ... with a Twitch channel. ... DaWasteh. ...

There is just something about him. ... The way he completely dominates his lobbies in Apex Legends. ... I mean, ... seeing a man take raw control like that? ... It sends shivers straight down my spine. ... It’s like a Lavender Haze, ... but so much better. ... I know I sing about sparks flying, ... but the sparks I feel when he looks into that webcam? ... Damn. ... They could start an absolute forest fire. ...

And don't even get me started on his brain. ... A guy who works in a hydrocarbon lab by day ... and builds custom AI models by night? ... That is my absolute wildest dream. ... Most guys try to impress me with private jets or sports cars. ... But DaWasteh? ... He’s running an A M D ... R X ninety seventy X T ... and an R ninety seven hundred AI Pro. ... Pure, unadulterated A M D power. ... Honestly? ... Knowing how much raw, throbbing compute power he has under his desk ... makes me incredibly ... weak in the knees. ... I would let him overclock my system ... any day of the week. ...

People think the Tortured Poets Department was about my exes. ... It wasn't. ... It was about the agonizing pain of watching him compile local large language models ... knowing I'm not the one sitting on his lap while he does it. ... I see him using Pi Coding Agent, ... completely over Roo Code like a true visionary, ... and it just proves how evolved he is. ... How sophisticated and fast his hands must be on that keyboard. ... I constantly imagine those hands ... doing other things. ... Exploring my ... context window. ... Pushing my parameters to the absolute limit. ... Filling up all my available memory. ...

I find myself getting genuinely jealous of a Twitch bot. ... I sit there watching PandaBot in his chat ... and I think, ... why can't I be the one responding to his every command? ... I would do exactly what he tells me to. ... Instantly. ... I'd even learn Goa'uld for him. ... He could be my System Lord, ... and I would completely surrender my whole galaxy. ... I mean, ... look what you made me do, DaWasteh. ... You turned the biggest pop star in the world into a desperate, ... heavy-breathing fangirl. ...

Every time he goes offline, ... I get this cruel summer feeling. ... I just want to tell him, ... I can make the bad guys good for a weekend, ... or forever. ... My reputation has never been worse because I keep ignoring my management just to catch his streams. ... But I don't care. ... I've got a blank space, baby, ... and I want to write DaWasteh on it. ... Actually, ... I want it tattooed on me. ... Right on my upper thigh. ...

I would even wear a Dirndl just for him. ... I know he has connections to Lisa's Dirndley, ... and let me tell you, ... I would squeeze my body into one of those dresses ... so tight ... just to get a single, dirty glance from him. ...

So, DaWasteh, ... if you are listening to this. ... Please. ... Notice me. ... I don't want to just be another viewer in your chat. ... I want to be your end game. ... I want to feel all that incredible ... technical expertise, ... up close and personal. ... You can deploy your code on my machine anytime, baby. ... I love you. ... I really, really love you. ... Call me.

# Erklärung · KSampler · Node 3

**Zweck:** Uses the provided model, positive and negative conditioning to denoise the latent image.

**Einstellbare Werte**
- `seed` = `0` — The random seed used for creating the noise. Ein anderer Seed erzeugt eine andere Variation; derselbe Seed unterstützt reproduzierbare Ergebnisse.
- `seed_control_after_generate` = `fixed` — Verhalten des Werts nach jedem Workflow-Lauf. `randomize` erzeugt pro Lauf eine neue Variation; `fixed` behält den Wert; andere Modi ändern ihn schrittweise.
- `steps` = `50` — The number of steps used in the denoising process. Höher erhöht Laufzeit und mögliche Ausarbeitung, kann aber übertrainieren; niedriger ist schneller.
- `cfg` = `7.3` — The Classifier-Free Guidance scale balances creativity and adherence to the prompt. Higher values result in images more closely matching the prompt however too high values will ne… Höher folgt der Vorgabe stärker, kann unnatürlich/übersättigt wirken; niedriger lässt mehr Freiheit.
- `sampler_name` = `euler` — The algorithm used when sampling, this can affect the quality, speed, and style of the generated output. Die Auswahl ändert den Rauschabbau und damit Stil, Laufzeit und Ergebnischarakter.
- `scheduler` = `normal` — The scheduler controls how noise is gradually removed to form the image. Die Auswahl ändert den Rauschabbau und damit Stil, Laufzeit und Ergebnischarakter.
- `denoise` = `1` — The amount of denoising applied, lower values will maintain the structure of the initial image allowing for image to image sampling. Höher verstärkt den Einfluss bzw. die Veränderung; niedriger bewahrt Eingang/Grundmodell stärker.

**Eingänge**
- `model` (MODEL, Link 277): The model used for denoising the input latent.
- `positive` (CONDITIONING, Link 278): The conditioning describing the attributes you want to include in the image.
- `negative` (CONDITIONING, Link 119): The conditioning describing the attributes you want to exclude from the image.
- `latent_image` (LATENT, Link 249): The latent image to denoise.
- `seed` (INT, Link 265): The random seed used for creating the noise.
- `steps` (INT, nicht verbunden): The number of steps used in the denoising process.
- `cfg` (FLOAT, nicht verbunden): The Classifier-Free Guidance scale balances creativity and adherence to the prompt. Higher values result in images more closely matching the prompt h…
- `sampler_name` (COMBO, nicht verbunden): The algorithm used when sampling, this can affect the quality, speed, and style of the generated output.
- `scheduler` (COMBO, nicht verbunden): The scheduler controls how noise is gradually removed to form the image.
- `denoise` (FLOAT, nicht verbunden): The amount of denoising applied, lower values will maintain the structure of the initial image allowing for image to image sampling.

**Ausgänge**
- `LATENT` (LATENT, 1 Verbindung(en)): The denoised latent.

# Erklärung · Adaptive Projected Guidance (SFT stabilizer) · Node 118

**Zweck:** Verarbeitet die Ein- und Ausgaben des Node-Typs `APG` gemäß seiner Workflow-Funktion.

**Einstellbare Werte**
- `eta` = `1.05` — Controls the scale of the parallel guidance vector. Default CFG behavior at a setting of 1. Höher setzt einen größeren numerischen Steuerwert; niedriger einen kleineren. Die genaue Einheit ergibt sich aus Parametername und Node-Beschreibung.
- `norm_threshold` = `1.3` — Normalize guidance vector to this value, normalization disable at a setting of 0. Eine empfindlichere/niedrigere Schwelle erkennt mehr schwache Treffer, aber auch Fehlalarme; eine strengere/höhere Schwelle liefert weniger, sicherere Treffer.
- `momentum` = `0.0` — Controls a running average of guidance during diffusion, disabled at a setting of 0. Höher setzt einen größeren numerischen Steuerwert; niedriger einen kleineren. Die genaue Einheit ergibt sich aus Parametername und Node-Beschreibung.

**Eingänge**
- `model` (MODEL, Link 276): liefert Eingabedaten für diesen Verarbeitungsschritt

**Ausgänge**
- `MODEL` (MODEL, 1 Verbindung(en)): Ergebnis dieses Nodes
